[[Lega Basket Serie A|Serie A]] | team = Orlandina Basket | birth_date = {{birth date and age|1998|01|04|df=y}} | birth_place = [[Marijampolė]], Lithuania | nationality = Lithuanian | draft_year = | draft_round = | draft_team = | career_start = 2014 | career_end = | highlights = | team1 = [[BC Žalgiris-2|Žalgiris-2]] | years1 = 2014–2015 | team2 = [[Brose Bamberg]] | years2 = 2015–present | team3 = →[[Baunach Young Pikes]] | years3 = 2015–2017 | team4 = →[[Orlandina Basket|Orlandina]] | years4 = 2017–present | awards = * First Team All-Eurocamp (2017) * [[Basketball Champions League|Champions League]] Best Young Player ([[2017–18 Basketball Champions League|2018]]) | medal_templates = {{MedalSport | Men's [[basketball]]}} {{MedalCountry| {{flagicon|LIT}} [[Lithuania men's national basketball team|Lithuania]]}} {{MedalCompetition|[[FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]]}} {{MedalSilver| [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|2016 Turkey]] | [[Lithuania men's national under-18 and under-19 basketball team|U18 National Team]]}} {{MedalBronze| [[2015 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship|2015 Greece]] | [[Lithuania men's national under-18 and under-19 basketball team|U18 National Team]]}} }} '''Arnoldas Kulboka''' (born 4 January 1998 in [[Marijampolė]]) is a [[Lithuania]]n professional [[basketball]] player. He is signed with [[Brose Bamberg]], currently on loan to [[Orlandina Basket]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A|Serie A]]. ==Playing career== Kulboka played in the youth ranks of [[BC Žalgiris|Žalgiris Kaunas]] until he signed a five-year deal with German powerhouse [[Brose Bamberg]] in August 2015.{{Cite web|url=http://www.brosebamberg.de/unser-team/das-team-201617/11-arnoldas-kulboka/|title=#11 Arnoldas Kulboka - Brose Bamberg|website=www.brosebamberg.de|access-date=13 November 2016}} In his first year, he exclusively saw action on their affiliated teams in the German under-19 Bundesliga NBBL (TSV Breitengüßbach) and in the second German division [[ProA|2. Bundesliga ProA]] ([[Baunach Young Pikes]]). He helped Breitengüßbach capture the 2016 NBBL title,{{Cite web|url=http://www.tsvbrgb.de/index.php/nbbl/659-nbbl-ist-deutscher-meister-2016|title=TSV Breitengüßbach e.V. - NBBL IST DEUTSCHER MEISTER 2016|last=Ahlf|first=Lina-Theresa|website=www.tsvbrgb.de|access-date=13 November 2016}} while averaging 6.4 points as well as 1.5 rebounds a contest for Baunach in ProA play.{{Cite web|url=http://www.zweite-basketball-bundesliga.de/teams/kader/spieler/2486/?|title=2. Basketball-Bundesliga {{!}} Spieler|website=www.zweite-basketball-bundesliga.de|access-date=13 November 2016}} In 2016, he attended the [[Basketball Without Borders]] Global Camp in [[Toronto]], [[Canada]]{{Cite web|url=http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Arnoldas-Kulboka-83108/|title=DraftExpress NBA Draft Prospect Profile: Arnoldas Kulboka, Stats, Comparisons, and Outlook|website=www.draftexpress.com|access-date=13 November 2016}} as well as the Adidas Eurocamp in Treviso.{{Cite web|url=http://www.adidaseurocamp.com/eurocamp-2016-roster/|title=EUROCAMP 2016 Roster {{!}} adidas Eurocamp|website=www.adidaseurocamp.com|access-date=18 November 2016}} In the 2016–17 season, he improved his stats to 14.7 points, 4.3 rebounds and 2 assists per game for Baunach in ProA action. On 1 May 2017, Kulboka made his debut for [[Brose Bamberg]] in a 61–74 win over [[Science City Jena]], in which he recorded 13 points and 5 rebounds.[http://www.easycredit-bbl.de/de/n/spielberichte/2016-17/nachbericht/2017-05-01-jen-bam/#urlNotFound 74:61-Erfolg in Jena: Bamberg geht mit sechs Siegen in Serie in die Playoffs] In June 2017, Kulboka participated in adidas Eurocamp. He was named best sniper of the camp by scoring 10 three-pointers in a row.{{cite web|title=10 tritaškių iš eilės pataikęs Kulboka – geriausias „Eurocamp“ snaiperis|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-110473-10-tritaskiu-is-eiles-pataikes-kulboka-geriausias-eurocamp-snaiperis.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=11 June 2017|language=lt}} Furthermore, he was also named to the First Team All-Eurocamp 2017.{{cite web|title=2017 Awards|url=http://adidaseurocamp.com/2017-awards/|website=adidas Eurocamp|accessdate=23 June 2017}}{{cite web|title=Arnoldas Kulboka – simboliniame prestižinės stovyklos penketuke|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-110485-arnoldas-kulboka-simboliniame-prestizines-stovyklos-penketuke.html|website=BasketNews.lt|accessdate=11 June 2017|language=lt}} During the same year, Kulboka declared for the [[2017 NBA draft]] but withdrew on June 12.{{cite web|title=Masiulis ir Kulboka pateikė paraiškas dalyvauti NBA naujokų biržoje|url=https://www.basketnews.lt/news-109077-masiulis-ir-kulboka-pateike-paraiskas-dalyvauti-nba-naujoku-birzoje.html|website=BasketNews.lt|language=lt}}{{cite web|last1=Sarapas|first1=Jaunius|title=Atsitraukė ir A. Kulboka, ir L. Birutis – NBA naujokų biržoje nebus nė vieno lietuvio|url=http://www.delfi.lt/nba/naujienos/atsitrauke-ir-a-kulboka-ir-l-birutis-nba-naujoku-birzoje-nebus-ne-vieno-lietuvio.d?id=74916202|website=DELFI|accessdate=12 June 2017}} On 14 July 2017, he joined [[Orlandina Basket]] of the Italian [[Lega Basket Serie A|Serie A]] on loan.{{Cite news|url=http://www.orlandinabasket.it/a-new-kid-in-town-arnoldas-kulboka-a-capo-dorlando/|title=A New Kid In Town: Arnoldas Kulboka a Capo d’Orlando!|date=14 July 2017|work=Orlandina Basket|access-date=14 July 2017|language=it-IT}} After averaging 10.3 points, 5 rebounds and 1.1 assists per game during the [[2017–18 Basketball Champions League]] season, he was named as the Best Young Player of the season.{{cite web|title=Arnoldas KULBOKA|url=http://www.championsleague.basketball/17-18/Arnoldas-Kulboka|website=championsleague.basketball|accessdate=5 May 2018}}{{cite web|title=Star Lineup revealed, Kulboka Best Young Player|url=http://www.championsleague.basketball/17-18/news/star-lineup-revealed-kulboka-best-young-player|website=championsleague.basketball|accessdate=5 May 2018|language=en}} Near the end of the season, Kulboka would enter his name in the [[2018 NBA draft]], being one of only 11 international players to declare for the draft early that year.{{cite web |title=Forty-three international early entry candidates withdraw from NBA Draft 2018 |url=http://www.nba.com/article/2018/06/12/forty-three-international-early-entry-candidates-withdraw-nba-draft-2018 |website=NBA.com |accessdate=June 18, 2018 |date=June 12, 2018}} ==National team career== Kulboka has represented Lithuania on the international stage on several occasions, including the [[2014 FIBA Europe Under-16 Championship]]{{Cite web|url=http://www.fibaeurope.com/compID_YUjW-7-FJ,kK9s431Lyr41.season_2014.roundID_9771.teamID_2135.playerID_115872.html|title=Arnoldas Kulboka - U16 European Championship Men (2014)|website=www.fibaeurope.com|access-date=13 November 2016}} and [[2015 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]].{{Cite web|url=http://u18men.fibaeurope.com/en/compID_8aYeHlfuGF-mF5IqO8aFH1.season_2015.roundID_11484.teamID_2135.playerID_115872.html|title=Arnoldas Kulboka - U18 Europe Championship Men - Division A|website=u18men.fibaeurope.com|access-date=13 November 2016}} He scored a team-high 15.7 points a game in the [[2016 FIBA Europe Under-18 Championship]] en route to a silver medal.{{Cite web|url=http://www.fiba.com/europe/u18/2016/Lithuania|title=Lithuania at the FIBA U18 European Championship Division A 2016 - FIBA.com|website=FIBA.com|access-date=22 December 2016}} He competed for Lithuania in the [[2017 FIBA Under-19 Basketball World Cup]], averaging a team-high 13.7 points per contest.{{Cite web|url=http://www.fiba.basketball/fr/world/u19/2017/Lithuania|title=Lithuanie at the FIBA U19 Basketball World Cup 2017 - FIBA.basketball|website=FIBA.basketball|language=fr|access-date=9 July 2017}} On 26 February 2018, Kulboka debuted as a member of the [[Lithuania men's national basketball team|Lithuania national team]] by scoring 9 points, grabbing 5 rebounds and dishing out 2 assists, and helped to crush the [[Kosovo national basketball team|Kosovo national team]] 106–50 during the [[2019 FIBA Basketball World Cup qualification]].{{cite web|title=Jauna Lietuvos rinktinė su kaupu išnaudojo savo šansą: antrąkart sutriuškintas Kosovas|url=https://www.delfi.lt/krepsinis/naujienos/jauna-lietuvos-rinktine-su-kaupu-isnaudojo-savo-sansa-antrakart-sutriuskintas-kosovas.d?id=77276817|website=DELFI.lt|accessdate=26 February 2018}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links== * [http://www.fiba.com/pages/eng/fc/gamecent/p/pid/6064639/playerview.html Profile at fiba.com] * [http://basketball.eurobasket.com/player/Arnoldas_Kulboka/Germany/Baunach-Young-Pikes/332957 Profile at eurobasket.com] {{DEFAULTSORT:Kulboka, Arnoldas}} [[Category:1998 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Baunach Young Pikes players]] [[Category:Brose Bamberg players]] [[Category:Lithuanian men's basketball players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Orlandina Basket players]]
